60c; color: #e9eef7; } body { margin: 0; padding: 18px; background: radial-gradient(circle at top, #101a2e, #04060c 65%); } h1 { margin: 0 0 6px; font-size: 18px; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; } p { color: #9aaac4; max-width: 820px; } code { color: #f2c178; } button { border: 1px solid #6fc2b4; background: #0b101d; color: #e9eef7; padding: 7px 12px; cursor: pointer; } .layout { display: grid; gap: 14px; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 320px; } iframe { width: 100%; min-height: 620px; border: 1px solid #1c2740; background: #04060c; } pre { min-height: 300px; padding: 12px; overflow: auto; border: 1px solid #1c2740; background: #070b14; color: #b9d5cd; } @media (max-width: 900px) { .layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
